name: Touring the Grounds
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, adventurer. May the light be your guide.
narrative.objectives: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
narrative.offerRewardText: Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.My name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.There's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.
narrative.requestItemsText: Welcome to Bandarion Keep, champion. It's always good to see a new face.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 11, 1,315 XP in all.
